exercises.prompt: Połącz zwroty z tłumaczeniem.

exercises.prompt: It ___ be argued that the policy has failed. (można)
___ is growing evidence that diet affects mood.
The participants ___ asked to complete a questionnaire.
Which sentence is the most academic?
exercises.answer: A considerable number of respondents expressed concern.
distractors: Lots of people were really worried.
I think a lot of people got worried.

exercises.prompt: According with Smith (2020), the results are reliable.

exercises.prompt: Which phrase is NOT suitable for an academic text?

Zamień na zdanie bezosobowe, zacznij od „It is widely believed”.
Many people believe that exercise improves memory.
exercises.answer: It is widely believed that exercise improves memory.

exercises.prompt: Połącz wyrażenia z tłumaczeniem.
Compared ___ urban areas, rural areas have fewer doctors.
Social media ___ to amplify extreme opinions. (ma tendencję)
As Kowalski (2019) points ___, the data are incomplete.
The ___ of the new system took two years.
The data was collected from 2015 to 2020 and they shows a clear trend.
Wyniki wydają się potwierdzać hipotezę.
Istnieje tendencja do przeceniania własnych umiejętności.
exercises.answer: There is a tendency to overestimate one's own abilities.
accept: There is a tendency to overestimate our own abilities.
There is a tendency for people to overestimate their own abilities.
People tend to overestimate their own abilities.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses hedging?
exercises.answer: This may be partly due to economic factors.
distractors: This is due to economic factors.
Economic factors are the only reason.

exercises.prompt:
Zamień na nominalizację, zacznij od „The introduction of”.
When the government introduced the tax, prices rose.
exercises.answer: The introduction of the tax led to a rise in prices.
accept: The introduction of the tax caused prices to rise.
The introduction of the tax resulted in a rise in prices.
The introduction of the tax led to higher prices.
